cast.name: 莉娜 曼勒 Lena Mantler

introduction: In the midst of their thrilling skateboarding journey, a quartet faces unexpected challenges that put their friendship and goals to the test. As summer unfolds, the intricacies of love bring a new dimension to their adventures. The shared history of sisters Alex and Juli casts shadows on their present, adding layers of complexity to the GetUp crew dynamics. Tensions rise within the group, and quarrels become inevitable, threatening the unity required to conquer the upcoming skate contest. Amidst the hurdles, they find themselves navigating not only the skate park's twists and turns but also the intricate twists of their relationships. The resilience of the GetUp crew will be truly tested as they strive to overcome these obstacles, with the allure of a joint inter-rail trip and new boards hanging in the balance.
